# `gsa_iolp_properties`

**GSA IOLP property observations**

Each GSA IOLP property in one declared buildings distribution, with native location identity, address, source units and original row evidence.

**Coverage.** Not a range. Complete caller-selected dated GSA IOLP workbook pair. A replacement selects a new complete snapshot; earlier immutable generations and originals remain retained. A missing row does not establish disposal, lease termination or source deletion. Coverage is GSA inventory, not government-wide FRPP. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `gsa_iolp_properties.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `snapshot_id` | `VARCHAR` | Identity of the exact selected catalog and workbook pair, including capture pins. |
| `snapshot_date` | `DATE` | Date label in both selected distribution filenames; not an inferred effective inventory date. |
| `location_code` | `VARCHAR` | Literal native GSA Location Code; use with snapshot_id for property joins. |
| `asset_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Real Property Asset Name. |
| `installation_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Installation Name; N/A remains text and is not rewritten as null. |
| `gsa_region` | `VARCHAR` | Literal GSA-assigned region code, not a geographic boundary or numeric quantity. |
| `street_address` | `VARCHAR` | Source building street address; not standardized, geocoded or independently verified. |
| `city` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source building city; a missing value remains null. |
| `state` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source building state or territory code; no geographic correction is inferred. |
| `zip_code` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source ZIP code including leading zeros, hyphens and ZIP+4 where supplied. |
| `latitude_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source latitude in decimal degrees; retain digits and inspect location_status before mapping. |
| `longitude_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source longitude in decimal degrees; retain digits and inspect location_status before mapping. |
| `rentable_square_feet_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Building Rentable Square Feet; building-level area can repeat across leases. Do not sum lease rows as independent building areas. |
| `available_square_feet_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Available Square Feet; null remains unknown, separate from zero. The measure describes building space. |
| `congressional_district` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source congressional district code, including leading zeros. District vintage is unstated. |
| `ownership_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Owned or Leased value for properties, or Federal Leased Code for leases. |
| `ownership` | `VARCHAR` | Owned or leased meaning mapped from the admitted source code; unknown codes refuse the build. |
| `asset_type` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Real Property Asset Type, such as BUILDING; land and structure rows are not relabelled as buildings. |
| `representative` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source representative label; not a verified current member or district join. |
| `area_unit` | `VARCHAR` | Square feet, as the source headers define; no area conversion or rounding is applied. |
| `coordinate_unit` | `VARCHAR` | Decimal degrees for source latitude/longitude; coordinate reference datum is unstated. |
| `address_scope` | `VARCHAR` | States that the address belongs to the source building and has no geocoding/standardization claim. |
| `location_status` | `VARCHAR` | Present but unvalidated, explicit missing fields, invalid coordinates, or a pinned unresolved source conflict. No full geographic audit is implied. |
| `location_issue` | `VARCHAR` | Exact-byte reviewed unresolved location issue, or null when no bounded review finding is recorded. Null does not establish correctness. |
| `value_states_json` | `VARCHAR` | JSON map distinguishing absent cell, explicit null, empty text and value. Lease-date parsing also records unparsed values. |
| `source_record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Source-kind-scoped native key, distinct from snapshot identity. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the exact retained original workbook. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Durable catalog-stated original downloadURL; temporary signed redirects are excluded. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Capture time of this exact workbook response; separate from its distribution date label and lease dates. |
| `source_sheet` | `VARCHAR` | Literal worksheet name containing the source record. |
| `source_row_number` | `BIGINT` | One-based original worksheet row number; header is row 1. |
| `source_locator_json` | `VARCHAR` | Original workbook URL, SHA-256, sheet and one-based row locator. |
| `raw_fields_json` | `VARCHAR` | Every literal source field including unknown columns, empty text and null; no value correction is hidden. |
| `raw_cells_json` | `VARCHAR` | Present original cells with coordinates, literal values, encoding kinds, number formats and source date facts. Omitted cells stay distinguishable. |
| `construction_year_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Construction Date from the property distribution, normally a year. Not expanded to a day or inferred age. |
| `building_status` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source Building Status; no current occupancy or disposal conclusion is inferred. |
